output.title: Warm Glow Typography with Lens Flares & Smooth Zoom Effects

prompts.prompt: Create a warm, cinematic title preset with elegant script typography that features a subtle lens flare overlay system and smooth, continuous zoom effects. Think of this like a romantic film opening sequence - the text should feel like it's being written by golden light. The typography should appear with a graceful, handwritten reveal animation where each word flows into existence with a subtle glow that peaks and fades. Implement a multi-layered lens flare system that moves independently across the text, creating organic light leaks. The entire composition should have a gentle, breathing zoom (scale from 0.95 to 1.05) that gives life to static text. Use warm color temperatures (amber, gold, soft orange) with additive blend modes for the glow effects. Consider adding subtle film grain texture overlay for authenticity.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' containing multiple nested layers - background glow layer, main TextAtom, lens flare overlay layer using ShapeAtom circles with radial gradients. Typography: Use TextAtom with elegant script font like 'Dancing Script:400:normal' or 'Great Vibes:400:normal'. Apply word-by-word reveal using caption data timing with staggered opacity (0 to 1) and subtle translateY (-10px to 0). Lens Flares: Create 2-3 ShapeAtom circles with 'absolute' positioning, radial gradient fills (transparent to rgba(255,200,100,0.3)), and independent translateX/translateY animations on different timings (3-5 second loops). Use 'mix-blend-mode: screen' for light interaction. Zoom Effect: Apply continuous scale effect to main container - AnimationRange from {scale: 0.95} to {scale: 1.05} over 8 seconds with ease-in-out, set to loop. Glow: Use text-shadow with multiple layers: '0 0 20px rgba(255,200,100,0.8), 0 0 40px rgba(255,180,80,0.4), 0 0 60px rgba(255,160,60,0.2)'. Performance: Use transform for all animations, add 'will-change: transform, opacity' to animated elements. Container classes: 'flex items-center justify-center'. Consider fitDurationTo: 'children' for proper timing inheritance.

prompts.prompt: Design a dynamic kinetic typography preset inspired by modern music video editing - fast, punchy, and rhythmic. Each word should burst onto screen with explosive energy, scaling up from 0 to 100% with a slight overshoot bounce. Implement a continuous subtle camera shake/jitter effect that adds nervous energy. Words should have a warm glow that pulses in intensity, synchronized with their appearance timing. Add light streak effects that zip across the text horizontally at random intervals, like lens flares caught in motion. The entire composition should have a slight Dutch angle rotation (3-5 degrees) that slowly rocks back and forth. Think of this as typography that dances - each word is a beat drop.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Main Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center' and slight rotate transform. Typography Layout: Use nested BaseLayout for each word group with 'inline-flex flex-wrap gap-4' for word spacing. TextAtom Implementation: Individual TextAtom per word using caption word-level timing. Scale animation: {scale: 0, opacity: 0} to {scale: 1.1, opacity: 1} to {scale: 1} with spring easing over 0.3s per word. Glow Effect: Create internal effect preset 'glow-pulse' with alternating text-shadow intensity: '0 0 10px rgba(255,180,100,0.6)' to '0 0 30px rgba(255,200,120,1)' on 0.5s intervals. Camera Shake: Parent container with continuous subtle translate animations - translateX and translateY random between -2px and 2px, changing every 0.1s. Light Streaks: ShapeAtom rectangles with 'absolute h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-yellow-200 to-transparent opacity-60' animated with translateX from -100% to 200% over 0.8s at random intervals (use setTimeout in presetExecution). Dutch Angle: Parent container rotate animation from -3deg to 3deg over 4s with ease-in-out, reversed and looped. Warm Filter: Container style with filter: 'sepia(0.2) saturate(1.3)'. Use waveform effects if audio is available for beat-synchronized pulsing.

prompts.prompt: Develop a sophisticated, editorial-style preset with smooth, cinematic zooms reminiscent of documentary title sequences. The typography should fade in with a long, luxurious dissolve while simultaneously scaling from 85% to 100%. Implement a complex lens flare system with multiple bokeh circles that drift across the frame like out-of-focus lights. Add a subtle vignette that darkens the edges, drawing focus to the glowing center text. The text itself should have a warm, honey-colored glow with soft edges. Include a slow, hypnotic zoom that pulls the viewer into the text over the entire duration. Think Ken Burns effect meets luxury brand commercial.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Container Architecture: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-radial from-amber-900/20 to-black/40' for vignette. Main text container with 'absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center'. Typography: TextAtom with serif font like 'Playfair Display:700:normal', font-size responsive using 'text-6xl md:text-8xl'. Initial fade and scale: opacity 0 to 1 over 3s, scale 0.85 to 1 simultaneously with ease-out. Bokeh System: Create sub-preset 'bokeh-lights' with 5-7 ShapeAtom circles, each with 'absolute rounded-full' and varying sizes (w-20 to w-40). Apply gaussian blur filter: 'blur(8px)' and opacity 0.3. Each bokeh animates on independent path using translateX/translateY with different durations (8-15s) and ease-in-out. Ken Burns Zoom: Parent container continuous scale from 1 to 1.2 over total duration with linear easing. Glow Implementation: Multiple text-shadow layers - '0 0 30px rgba(255,215,0,0.5), 0 0 60px rgba(255,200,0,0.3), 0 0 90px rgba(255,185,0,0.2)' plus backdrop-filter: 'blur(0.5px)' for soft edges. Lens Flare Overlay: Additional ShapeAtom with radial gradient 'from-yellow-300/30 via-transparent to-transparent' animated across screen diagonally. Performance: Use transform-gpu for smooth scaling, containerProps.style for complex filters.

prompts.prompt: Create an energetic, YouTube-style kinetic typography preset with modern, attention-grabbing animations. Words should slide in from different directions (left, right, top, bottom) with motion blur effects during movement. Implement a dynamic glow system that flickers and surges like neon lights warming up. Add subtle lens flare 'pings' that appear at the moment each word locks into place. The overall composition should have a slight perspective tilt (transform3d) giving depth to the text. Include micro-animations like subtle character spacing changes and baseline shifts that keep the text feeling alive even when static.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Layout Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full perspective-1000' for 3D context. Word containers with 'absolute' positioning for individual control. Entry Animations: Use Array.from(captionData.words) to map different entry directions. Odd index words: translateX from -120% to 0, even index: translateX from 120% to 0. Apply motion blur during movement: filter 'blur(4px)' to 'blur(0px)'. Duration: 0.4s with ease-out per word, staggered by 0.1s. Neon Glow: Implement flickering effect using rapid opacity changes on text-shadow. Create effect sequence: full glow → dim → full over 0.2s when word appears. Text-shadow: '0 0 5px currentColor, 0 0 15px rgba(255,200,100,0.8), 0 0 25px rgba(255,180,80,0.6)'. Lens Flare Pings: ShapeAtom with 'absolute w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white' that scales from 0 to 3 and fades out over 0.3s at word position. 3D Tilt: Apply rotateX(5deg) rotateY(-5deg) to main container for depth. Micro-animations: Continuous letter-spacing animation from 0.02em to 0.04em over 2s, reversed and looped. Baseline shift using subtle translateY between -1px and 1px on 3s loop. Use requestAnimationFrame for smooth 60fps animations.

prompts.prompt: Build a dreamy, ethereal preset with floating typography that moves like it's underwater. Words should drift upward gently while fading in, creating a weightless feeling. Implement an aurora-like lens flare system with flowing gradients that shift colors from warm gold to soft amber. Add particle-like light motes that float around the text. The entire scene should have a slow, mesmerizing zoom that breathes in and out. Include soft focus effects that blur and sharpen rhythmically, like adjusting a camera lens. Think of this as typography suspended in liquid light.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Base Container: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-b from-amber-950/30 to-transparent'. Floating Typography: TextAtom components with individual word animations using caption data. Each word: translateY from 20px to -10px over 3s with ease-in-out, opacity 0 to 1 over 2s. Apply 'transform-style: preserve-3d' for depth. Aurora Lens Flares: Create custom gradient masks using multiple ShapeAtom layers with 'absolute inset-0'. Use linear gradients with animation: 'bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-amber-400/20 to-transparent' with translateX animation looping over 10s. Apply 'mix-blend-mode: soft-light'. Light Particles: Generate 10-15 small ShapeAtom circles with 'absolute w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-yellow-200/60'. Animate each on unique bezier curve path using keyframes for translateX/translateY. Duration: 5-8s per particle, staggered starts. Breathing Zoom: Container scale animation from 0.98 to 1.02 over 4s with ease-in-out, reversed and looped. Soft Focus: Animate filter from 'blur(0.5px)' to 'blur(0px)' to 'blur(1px)' over 3s cycle. Add 'backdrop-filter: blur(2px)' to create depth layers. Glow: Soft text-shadow '0 0 40px rgba(255,220,180,0.4)' with subtle animation on intensity.

prompts.prompt: Design a retro-futuristic kinetic typography preset inspired by 80s motion graphics with modern polish. Text should glitch-in with a digital cascade effect, letters appearing in rapid succession with trailing light echoes. Implement scanning lens flares that sweep across horizontally like CRT monitor refresh lines. Add chromatic aberration effects on the glow edges (red/blue color separation). The composition should have a subtle barrel distortion at edges and a constant slow push-in zoom. Include data-moshing style frame tears that occasionally distort the text for dynamic interest.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Main Layout: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-black overflow-hidden' and CSS filter for barrel distortion using transform. Digital Cascade: Use TextAtom with letter-by-letter animation. Each character appears with opacity 0→1 in 0.05s sequence. Add trailing echo effect: duplicate each letter as span with 'absolute' position, offset by 2px, opacity 0.3, delayed by 0.1s. Scanning Flares: ShapeAtom with 'absolute h-0.5 w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-cyan-400/50 to-transparent'. Animate translateY from -100% to 200% over 2s on loop. Add multiple scanlines with different delays and speeds. Chromatic Aberration: Apply to glow using split text-shadows: '2px 0 0 rgba(255,0,100,0.5), -2px 0 0 rgba(0,200,255,0.5), 0 0 20px rgba(255,200,100,0.6)'. Push Zoom: Continuous parent scale from 1 to 1.1 over entire duration with linear easing. Glitch Tears: Implement random transform: 'skewX()' animations. Use setTimeout to trigger random skew between -5deg and 5deg for 0.1s at random intervals. Add temporary 'mix-blend-mode: difference' during glitch. Retro Glow: Multiple shadow layers with warm orange-yellow tones, slight blur filter. Performance: Use CSS containment and will-change for complex animations.

prompts.prompt: Develop a premium, glass-morphism style preset with elegant refractive typography effects. Text should materialize through a crystallization animation - starting blurred and becoming sharp. Implement prismatic lens flares that split white light into rainbow spectrums as they pass over text. Add subtle caustic light patterns that dance across the surface like light through water. The composition should have a sophisticated parallax zoom where text layers move at different speeds. Include frosted glass overlay effects with subtle distortion at the edges.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Glass Container: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' and backdrop-filter: 'blur(10px) saturate(1.5)'. Add 'bg-white/5 border border-white/10' for glass effect. Crystallization Effect: TextAtom starting with filter: 'blur(20px)' and opacity: 0.3, animating to blur(0) and opacity: 1 over 2s with ease-out. Add transform: scale from 1.2 to 1 during same duration. Prismatic Flares: Create gradient overlay using ShapeAtom with 'absolute inset-0'. Use conic-gradient for rainbow effect: 'bg-gradient-conic from-red-500 via-yellow-500 via-green-500 via-blue-500 to-purple-500'. Animate with translateX and rotate for moving prism effect. Set opacity: 0.2 and 'mix-blend-mode: overlay'. Caustic Patterns: SVG filters or multiple ShapeAtom elements with turbulence/displacement effects. Create wave-like light patterns using animated gradients with 'mix-blend-mode: soft-light'. Parallax Layers: Split text into 3 depth layers using z-index. Each layer scales at different rate: foreground 1→1.15, middle 1→1.1, background 1→1.05 over duration. Frosted Edges: Apply mask-image with radial-gradient for soft edges. Add slight chromatic aberration at borders using box-shadow with color offsets. Refractive Glow: Complex text-shadow with multiple colors: '0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,0.5), 0 0 60px rgba(200,220,255,0.3)'. Use CSS custom properties for dynamic glow intensity.

prompts.prompt: Create a hand-crafted, artisanal typography preset that mimics stop-motion animation aesthetics with digital warmth. Words should appear with a subtle 'pop-in' effect as if placed by hand, with minor position irregularities that add charm. Implement organic, hand-drawn style lens flares using rough, imperfect shapes that wobble slightly. Add paper texture overlay with subtle shadows suggesting depth layers. The zoom should be stepped rather than smooth, creating a stop-motion camera feel. Include warm light leaks that bloom and fade organically around the text edges.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Handcrafted Layout: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-br from-orange-50 to-amber-50'. Add noise texture using CSS background-image SVG pattern. Stop-Motion Pop: TextAtom with stepped animation keyframes. Each word appears at specific frames: scale from 0.8 to 1.1 to 1 over 3 frames (0.12s). Add random rotate between -2deg and 2deg per word for imperfection. Position offset: random translateX/Y between -3px and 3px. Wobbling Flares: ShapeAtom with clip-path polygon creating irregular star shape. Animate points independently using CSS custom properties for wobble effect. Apply 'filter: blur(8px)' and opacity: 0.4. Use warm gradient fill 'from-yellow-300 to-orange-300'. Stepped Zoom: Container scale animation using steps(5) timing function. Scale from 0.95 to 1.05 over 2s, creating 5 distinct zoom positions. Paper Texture: Overlay div with 'absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none'. Apply multiply blend mode with subtle paper texture image. Add box-shadow inset for depth: 'inset 0 0 100px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)'. Light Leaks: Multiple radial gradients positioned around text using absolute ShapeAtoms. Animate opacity from 0 to 0.6 to 0 over 3s with irregular timing. Use 'mix-blend-mode: screen' for authentic light leak effect. Warm Glow: Soft, irregular text-shadow with multiple layers suggesting hand-painted light.

prompts.prompt: Build a broadcast-quality lower third preset with sophisticated motion design principles. Typography should slide in with perfectly timed ease curves while a subtle lens flare accent sweeps across like a highlight marker. Implement a professional depth-of-field effect where background elements are slightly blurred. Add broadcast-style edge glow that outlines text cleanly. The composition should have a documentary-style slow zoom that adds gravitas. Include subtle light contamination effects where bright areas slightly bleed into dark areas, creating realistic lens behavior.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Broadcast Layout: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' split into zones. Lower third area: 'absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full h-1/3'. Use grid for precise alignment: 'grid grid-cols-12 gap-4'. Professional Slide: TextAtom with translateX from -100% to 0 over 0.8s using cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for broadcast-standard easing. Add slight rotation correction: rotate from -0.5deg to 0 during slide. Lens Flare Accent: ShapeAtom with 'h-full w-px bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent via-white to-transparent opacity-80'. Animate translateX across text width over 0.6s with ease-in-out, delayed to coincide with text settlement. Depth of Field: Background layer with 'absolute inset-0 -z-10' and filter: 'blur(2px)'. Foreground text remains sharp. Add subtle bokeh shapes in background using blurred ShapeAtoms. Edge Glow: Use outline effect with text-stroke: '2px rgba(255,230,180,0.8)' and outer glow via text-shadow: '0 0 10px rgba(255,220,160,0.6)'. Documentary Zoom: Parent container with subtle scale from 1 to 1.03 over total duration using linear timing. Light Bleed: Create glow overflow using pseudo-elements with 'absolute -inset-2' and gradient borders. Apply 'filter: blur(4px)' and 'mix-blend-mode: screen'. Use Tailwind's 'before:' and 'after:' pseudo-class utilities. Performance: GPU acceleration with transform3d(0,0,0) hack, will-change on animated properties.

prompts.prompt: Design an organic, nature-inspired typography preset where text grows like living vines with golden sunlight filtering through. Words should unfurl with natural growth animations, starting from a seed point and expanding outward. Implement dancing lens flares that mimic sunlight through leaves - dappled, moving, alive. Add particle effects suggesting floating pollen or dust motes in warm light. The zoom should pulse gently like breathing. Include ray-traced style light shafts that pierce through the composition at angles, creating a forest canopy feeling.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Organic Container: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Add subtle radial gradient background 'bg-gradient-radial from-amber-900/10 via-transparent to-green-950/20'. Vine Growth Animation: TextAtom with custom path animation. Each word starts with scale: 0 and opacity: 0 at transform-origin set to 'bottom left'. Animate to scale: 1 and opacity: 1 over 1.5s with spring easing. Add slight rotation during growth: rotate from -5deg to 0. Stagger each word by 0.2s using caption timing. Dappled Light: Create multiple ShapeAtom circles with varying sizes (w-8 to w-20). Apply 'rounded-full bg-gradient-radial from-yellow-200/40 to-transparent'. Animate using complex translate paths mimicking wind movement - use sine wave calculations in presetExecution. Floating Particles: Generate 20+ tiny ShapeAtom dots with 'absolute w-0.5 h-0.5 rounded-full bg-yellow-100/70'. Each follows unique float path: translateY from 100% to -20% with varying translateX sine wave. Duration: 8-12s per particle. Breathing Zoom: Container animation with scale from 0.98 to 1.02 over 3s using ease-in-out, reversed and looped. Add subtle rotate oscillation: -0.5deg to 0.5deg. Light Shafts: Create using rotated rectangular ShapeAtoms with 'bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent via-yellow-100/20 to-transparent'. Position at angles using rotate(15deg) to rotate(45deg). Animate opacity for dynamic lighting. Natural Glow: Warm, soft text-shadow with multiple layers: '0 0 20px rgba(255,220,100,0.3), 0 0 40px rgba(255,200,50,0.2)'. Add inner glow using inset shadows.
